The chain rule gives the stated energy difference only under the explicitly required endpoint limits. Arbitrary candidate bundles assert no reducible-free Floer theory. There are no diagrams, interrupted-definition links or phase proofs. The title correction changes the item guard but leaves the Definition and its mathematical interface byte-identical.
